current_forecast.name: Overnight
current_forecast.detailed_forecast: A chance of showers and thunderstorms before 3am. Mostly cloudy. Low around 68, with temperatures rising to around 70 overnight. Northeast wind around 5 mph. Chance of precipitation is 30%. New rainfall amounts less than a tenth of an inch possible.

seven_day_forecast.name: Friday
seven_day_forecast.short_forecast: Chance Showers And Thunderstorms then Showers And Thunderstorms
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A slight chance of rain showers between 9am and 10am, then a chance of showers and thunderstorms between 10am and 11am, then showers and thunderstorms. Cloudy. High near 73, with temperatures falling to around 70 in the afternoon. Northeast wind 5 to 15 mph. Chance of precipitation is 90%. New rainfall amounts between a half and three quarters of an inch possible.

seven_day_forecast.name: Saturday
seven_day_forecast.short_forecast: Chance Showers And Thunderstorms then Slight Chance Showers And Thunderstorms
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A chance of showers and thunderstorms before 7am, then a slight chance of showers and thunderstorms between 7am and 1pm. Mostly sunny, with a high near 70. North wind around 15 mph, with gusts as high as 30 mph. Chance of precipitation is 40%.

seven_day_forecast.name: Sunday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: Sunny, with a high near 74. North wind around 5 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Monday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: Mostly sunny, with a high near 78. Southwest wind 0 to 10 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Wednesday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A slight chance of showers and thunderstorms after 7am. Mostly sunny, with a high near 87. Southwest wind 5 to 15 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Thursday
